data_description.mode: Choose to filter by administrative district or by a coordinate + radius.
data_description.location: Pick a position on the map. Defaults to your Home Assistant home location.
data_description.radius_km: Defaults to 10 km. Alerts are matched if their area passes within this radius.
data_description.exclude_sea: Exclude marine warnings (e.g., sea level, wind at sea).
data_description.include_messages: The integration always shows warnings. Enable this option to also show messages, which can, for example, be a risk.
data_description.include_geometry: Attach GeoJSON geometry for each warning area to the sensor attributes so UI cards can draw the affected area. This can increase entity state size.
data_description.message_types: Choose which message categories to include when Show messages is enabled.
data_description.fire_risk_enabled: Create separate sensors for forest fire risk, grass fire risk and forest fuel drying, with daily forecasts. These forecasts do not affect issued warning counts and do not indicate whether a fire ban applies.
data_description.fire_risk_location: Choose or confirm the exact forecast point, also when warnings use a district. The initial suggestion is your Home Assistant home location. SMHI provides this product for land and inland waters in Sweden; other points can have no data. The warning radius does not apply.
data_description.thunder_probability_enabled: Show thunderstorm probability at the next forecast time and the forecast for the coming 48 hours. This is a local forecast, not an issued warning.
data_description.thunder_probability_location: Choose or confirm the exact forecast point. The initial suggestion is your Home Assistant home location. This point is independent of the warning filter and fire risk location; the warning radius does not apply. Points outside SMHI’s forecast area can have no data.
data_description.winter_enabled: Show precipitation type, frozen precipitation probability and temperature at the next forecast time, with a forecast for the coming 48 hours. These are local forecasts, not snow depth, road conditions or issued warnings.
data_description.winter_location: Choose or confirm the exact forecast point. The initial suggestion is your Home Assistant home location. This point is independent of the warning filter and other local forecasts; the warning radius does not apply. Points outside SMHI’s forecast area can have no data.
